abilities.name: Raphanus Sky Cluster

_curatorNotes: Radish DMG tick authored 2026-08-17 (gauge round L5e residue). gcsim yaoyao/yaoyao.go Init() → c.skillRadishAI: Element Dendro, Durability 25 (1U), Mult skillRadishDMG[TalentLvlSkill()]; zz_yaoyao.dm.go skillRadishDMG index 9 (TL10) = 0.53856 → 53.856%. Cross-check sidecar docs/curation/talents/yaoyao.json talents.skill.rows[0] 'White Jade Radish DMG' col 10 = '53.9%'.

Cadence from yuegui.go: newYueguiThrow sets ThinkInterval=29 for the first throw, and throw() resets ThinkInterval=60 → interval 60f = 1s. Each throw does QueueCharTask(..., travelDelay-1 = 12) and then QueueAttackWithSnap(delay 1), so the first hit lands 29+12+1 = 42f after spawn → firstTickDelay 0.700 (same frame as the sibling radish heal, which is Tasks.Add on the identical delay). ⚠️ The gcsim-frames-diff §5 row measures first hit at 104f from cast start; spawnsAt is 63 (skillCDStart 15 + yueguiThrowSpawn 48), giving 41f = 0.683 — a 1-frame disagreement with the Go. Authored the Go number per the curation rule; observed interval 60f × 10 agrees exactly.

icdGate authored 2026-08-17 (ICD-group round b), correcting this note's original 'standard' reading: skillRadishAI uses ICDGroupYaoyaoRadishSkill, whose table entry (pkg/core/attacks/icd_groups.dm.go) shares standard's 150f timer but applies only the FIRST hit of each window rather than every 3rd. Measured 4/10, which standard also gives at this 60f interval — which is exactly how the old note came to call the group standard when only its EFFECT on one cadence was observable. ⚠️ It does not survive a different cadence: at C6, or with a second Yuegui coexisting, the two rules diverge.

C6 variance NOT authored as a series: yuegui.go throw() fires yg.c6(target) on throwCounter 2 and 5 (the 3rd and 6th skill-Yuegui throws only, c6TravelDelay 20) — an extra Mega Radish entity with its own multiplier, not a change to this cadence or tick count. C0 authored; C6's extra radishes remain unmodelled here.

Not modelled: up to 2 Yuegui: Throwing Mode can coexist (existing geometry note), so a real double-skill rotation applies twice this cadence. Radishes thrown while Adeptal Legacy is active switch to burstRadishAI (yuegui.go getInfos) — a different multiplier and ICD group on the same summon; only the skill-state series is authored.

Generator behavior 'stance' changed to 'instant' — Yaoyao does not enter a stance; the skill spawns a Yuegui: Throwing Mode entity and returns to normal control. | Frames: N and Q keys omitted — neither ActionAttack nor ActionBurst have explicit overrides after InitAbilSlice(52); both default to AnimationLength=52. | Skill frames are for Tap only; Hold variant (aiming mode to adjust throw direction) exists in-game but is not separately modeled in gcsim — hold frames not available. | Generator variants[] ('Yuegui Throwing Mode' duration 10s, 'White Jade Radish' duration 5s) described entity lifetimes, not ability variants with distinct animations — removed. Yuegui: Throwing Mode lifetime (10s = 600f from yuegui.go Duration=600) is now modeled in summons[]. Radish unexploded duration (5s) is not modeled (entity lifecycle detail; reviewer to assess). | spawnsAt=63: skill spawns Yuegui at skillCDStart(15) + yueguiThrowSpawn(48) = 63f per skill.go. | A maximum of 2 Yuegui: Throwing Mode can coexist; recasting does not terminate existing ones (no terminatesOn set).

Radish heal authored 2026-07-12 as a summonTick heal on Yuegui: Throwing Mode (Kuki Sanctifying Ring / Diona Drunken Mist shape). Cadence from gcsim yuegui.go: first throw at ThinkInterval=29f after spawn, then every 60f (ThinkInterval reset to 60 inside throw()); each radish travels travelDelay=13f before exploding + healing, so first heal ~42f (0.7s) after Yuegui spawn, then every 1s → interval 1, firstTickDelay 0.7. TL10 heal: skillRadishHealing[0][9]=0.030857 (3.09% Max HP) + skillRadishHealing[1][9]=363.20334 (sidecar 'White Jade Radish Healing' col 10 = '3.09% Max HP+363'). Snapshots Yaoyao's Max HP + Healing Bonus at Yuegui spawn (c.Snapshot in newYueguiThrow).

Target 'team' (matches capability fixture): in-game the radish is thrown at the party member with the LOWEST HP% (when nearby chars ≤70% HP) and heals the small AoE around them. gcsim simplifies to Player.Active() (yuegui.go heal(): HealInfo.Target defaults to 0 → reassigned to Active()), but that is a sim convenience — Yaoyao's defining role is off-field lowest-HP healing, so target 'active' would misclassify her. Schema has no lowest-HP target primitive; 'team' + caveat is the honest closest fit. All-chars->70% HP → radish thrown at enemy, no heal (not modelled). A4 In Others' Shoes (+0.8% Max HP/s for 5s on radish hit) and C1 Dendro DMG buff remain on their own nodes.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — The 1s tick marks on the 10s Yuegui: Throwing Mode bar. The heal series is unconditional in our data, so the marks read as healing every second regardless of party HP. The 'shown as a team heal / lowest-HP ally' half has no pixel: the summon lane draws a labelled bar with marks and never says WHO is healed — `target: 'team'` is a Team Builder capability claim, and caveats do not reach the Team Builder (N17). Category: approximation-disclosure.

abilities.description:
Calls upon "Yuegui: Throwing Mode," a special device created by a certain adeptus to help Yaoyao solve her problems.
This skill will be used differently in Holding Mode.

Hold
Enters Aiming Mode to adjust the throw direction.

Yuegui: Throwing Mode
Throws out White Jade Radishes that will explode upon hitting characters or opponents, dealing Dendro DMG to opponents within a certain AoE, and healing characters within that same AoE based on Yaoyao's Max HP. If a radish does not hit either an opponent or a character, the radish will remain where it is and explode on contact with a character or opponent, or will explode after its duration expires.
Yuegui: Throwing Mode will choose its radish-throw targets.
·If all nearby characters have more than 70% HP remaining, then it will throw the radish at a nearby opponent.
·If nearby characters have 70% or less HP remaining, it will throw a radish at the character with the lowest HP percentage remaining. If no opponents exist nearby, Yuegui will also throw White Jade Radishes at characters if they all have more than 70% HP and less than 100% HP remaining. Otherwise, it will throw radishes into the area at random.

A maximum of 2 instances of Yuegui: Throwing Mode can exist at any one time.

abilities.name: Moonjade Descent

_curatorNotes: ↻ 2026-09-04: tickCap 4. ⚠️ A SIBLING HEAL SERIES ON THE SAME CADENCE MUST BE CAPPED TOO (tick-cap round, docs/gauge-round-L5e.md §4) — one gcsim task emits the radish's damage and its heal together, and the oracle cannot see the heal because it leaves no damage event. Uncapped it drew 6 heal marks where gcsim throws 4.

Burst radish DMG authored 2026-09-04 (stale-application[] pass) — the burst half of the series the SKILL has carried since the L5e residue pass (2026-08-17). Yuegui throws a White Jade Radish that heals AND deals Dendro DMG; only the heal was authored here, so the damage lived in the cast's application[] instead and the summon lane drew no damage marks at all. gcsim yaoyao.go:50 burstRadishAI: Dendro, Durability 25 (1U), Mult burstRadishDMG[TalentLvlBurst()]; zz_yaoyao.dm.go burstRadishDMG[9] = 1.29888 → 129.888%, cross-checked against the talent sidecar's burst row '129.9%'.

Cadence is a genuine FIXED interval, unlike Charlotte's and Qiqi's: yuegui.go sets ThinkInterval 29 for the first throw then 60 thereafter, and the radish travels travelDelay 13 — so firstTickDelay = (29+13)/60 = 0.7s and interval = 1s, identical to the skill's.

icdGate timer 90: gcsim ICDGroupYaoyaoRadishBurst (icd_groups.dm.go:123) is a 1.5s window with sequence {1,0,0,0,0,0} — only the first hit in the window applies. ⚠️ The SKILL's is 150 (2.5s); the two lineups are on different groups, which is why the gate is authored per series and not once for the character.

tickCap 4: gcsim removes every Yuegui at burstDur = 360f FROM THE CAST (burst.go:54), while our summon window is spawnsAt 104 + 6s = 464f. ⚓ A COUNT, never a time bound — the tick-cap round's rule, and the same shape as Mona: nudging the stated 6s duration would fix the ticks by making the ABILITY's active window wrong, since summons[0].duration is what resolves the bar's uptime. Throws land at 146/206/266/326; 386 would fall past 360.

⚓⚓ ONE YUEGUI IS MODELLED THOUGH THE BURST SPAWNS THREE (frames 104/162/221, burst.go:52-54), and that is MEASURED, not a shortcut. All three radishes carry ICDTagElementalBurst, so they share ONE ICD counter: gcsim's nine nominal throws gate down to applications at 145 and 262, and one Yuegui on this cadence gates to 146 and 266 — the same two, within four frames. The extra two Yuegui add DAMAGE and HEALING, which we do not print, and the ability caveat already states the healing frequency. ⛔ Do not author three summons for the gauge's sake: they share a label so they would collapse into one lane as overlapping bars, their durations would each have to encode 'ends at cast + 360', and their ICD correctness would rest on a key collision.

abilities.caveat: The timeline shows one Yuegui's once-per-second healing ticks; in game up to 3 run at once, so healing lands about three times as often.
_curatorNotes: Generator behavior 'stance' changed to 'instant' — Adeptal Legacy state does NOT replace normals/charge; Yaoyao retains full action freedom during burst. | Generator top-level duration: 5s removed; gcsim burstDur = 6*60 = 6s — discrepancy with genshin-db value of 5s; reviewer to verify in-game. | Up to 3 Yuegui: Jumping Mode spawn sequentially at frames 104, 162, and 221 (per burst.go QueueCharTask calls); each has Duration=-1 (lives until burst ends via removeBurst()); only first spawn frame (104) modeled in spawnsAt. | Adeptal Legacy ends when Yaoyao leaves the field — gcsim subscribes to OnCharacterSwap via onExitField(); terminatesOn: 'swap' on the summon reflects this. | Adeptal Legacy also grants +15% movement speed and increased dendro RES — not in effects[] (empty from generator); reviewer to add. | Radishes thrown during Adeptal Legacy use burstRadishAI (AttackTagElementalBurst) instead of skillRadishAI; this tag switch is not represented in effects[].

Radish heal authored 2026-07-12 as a summonTick heal on Yuegui: Jumping Mode. Same throw cadence as the skill Yuegui (yuegui.go: first throw 29f after spawn, then every 60f; +13f radish travel → first heal ~0.7s, then 1s) → interval 1, firstTickDelay 0.7. abilities.description:
At the enjoinment of a certain adeptus, Yuegui's full potential can be unleashed in an emergency, dealing Dendro DMG to nearby opponents and entering an (in some sense) unsurpassed Adeptal Legacy state.

Adeptal Legacy
·White Jade Radishes generated will be changed to heal and deal DMG according to this skill. Explosions will heal all nearby party members, and the Dendro DMG that they deal will be viewed as Elemental Burst DMG instead.
·Summons "Yuegui: Jumping Mode" at intervals until their limit has been reached. The behavior of this version of Yuegui is the same as that of "Yuegui: Throwing Mode" in the Elemental Skill, Raphanus Sky Cluster. A maximum of 3 Yuegui: Jumping Mode can exist at any one time.
·Yaoyao's Movement SPD is increased by 15%.
·Yaoyao's Dendro RES will be increased.

The Adeptal Legacy state will end once Yaoyao is off-field, and all remaining Yuegui: Jumping Mode will be cleared once this state ends.

passives.name: Starscatter
passives.description: While affected by the Adeptal Legacy state caused by Moonjade Descent, Yaoyao will constantly throw White Jade Radishes at nearby opponents when she is sprinting, jumping, or running. She can throw 1 White Jade Radish this way once every 0.6s.

passives.name: In Others' Shoes
_curatorNotes: Scaling buff: value field deleted — effect is 0.8% of Yaoyao's MaxHP per second for 5s. | Effect is a periodic heal, not a stat buff — generator typed it as 'buff' with stat 'hp%', which is incorrect; reviewer to re-type as 'heal' with duration 5s (a4Status = 5*60 frames). | Trigger is manual. Likely 'onHit' from radish explosion: radish.go calls radishHeal() which sets a4Status on the active character and queues a periodic heal task (every 60f for the status window). Probable trigger: 'onHit' conditioned on radish-type hit (skill or burst elemental art). Reviewer to wire.
passives.description: When White Jade Radishes explode, active characters within their AoE will regain HP every 1s based on 0.8% of Yaoyao's Max HP. This effect lasts 5s.

constellations.name: Adeptus' Tutelage
_curatorNotes: Trigger is manual. Likely 'onHit' from radish explosion — gcsim c1() is called from radishHeal(), which fires on any radish heal (skill or burst radishes; does not trigger on C6 Mega Radish per c6HealMsg guard). Dendro DMG Bonus buff always applies on radish heal (no ICD on the buff itself). Stamina restoration has a 5s ICD (c1ICDkey) but is separate from the buff — reviewer to decide if ICD applies to the buff trigger or only to the stamina restore. Probable trigger: 'onHit' with dendro element / elemental art or burst tag.
constellations.description: When White Jade Radishes explode, active characters within their AoE will gain 15% Dendro DMG Bonus for 8s and have 15 Stamina restored to them. This form of Stamina Restoration can only be triggered every 5s.

_curatorNotes: Triggers are manual. Mega Radish fires on throwCounter indices 2 and 5 within each Yuegui: Throwing Mode's throw sequence (per yuegui.go: counter % 3 check at positions 2 and 5). This is a gadget-internal periodic trigger, not a standard character action trigger — reviewer to wire. Each Yuegui: Throwing Mode can throw max 2 Mega Radishes total (throwCounter reaches 2 and 5). Effects: 75% ATK Dendro DMG (scaling: 75, stat: atk) and 7.5% MaxHP heal (scaling: 7.5, stat: hp) — skeletons look well-formed. Does not trigger C1 or A4 per c6HealMsg guard in radishHeal().
constellations.description:
For every 2 White Jade Radishes Yuegui: Throwing Mode throws out, the next throw will also release a Mega Radish that will have a larger AoE than the standard White Jade Radish and have the following effects upon exploding:
·Deals AoE Dendro DMG based on 75% of Yaoyao's ATK.
·Restores HP for the active character based on 7.5% of Yaoyao's Max HP.

Every Yuegui: Throwing Mode can throw out a maximum of 2 Mega Radishes.
